info.title: iPass → Pharos | Employee Access API
info.description: Employee-centric source-data ingestion from iPass. A person can have multiple distinct Okta accounts. No environment is supplied or inferred. Account identity: oktaAccountId. Role identity: entitlementValue. Role and assignment UUID keys are generated by PostgreSQL; oktaAccountId is used directly as the account primary key. New event: new UUID; identical retry: same UUID and payload. Delivery order must be preserved. Authentication is not implemented in the local API.

tags.name: Employee access
tags.description: One employee; one account snapshot for provisioning and updates. No environment classification.

post.summary: Send employee details and current Pharos roles
post.description: Send approved source data for one employee. Provisioning and updates carry the complete current role list for one Okta account; [] removes that account’s assignments only. Distinct source accounts stay separate. Termination closes all the employee’s current assignments in this database. Manager ID, firstName, middleName and lastName are required; middleName may be null; employee email may be null or omitted. No environment field, role-name convention or QA/Prod inference is required. Identical retries reuse the event UUID and payload.

01-first-provisioning.description: Create the employee and account with the complete approved role list.

02-remove-gsi.description: Omit GSI; retain every other current role for this account.

03-add-gdd.description: Include GDD together with every existing current role for this account.

07-remove-all-roles.description: Send iPassRoles: []; employment remains ACTIVE and the account has no current roles.

04-termination.description: Close current assignments across all employee accounts immediately.

05-termination-correction.description: Send the approved ACTIVE profile and current roles for the account being restored.

requestBody.description: Complete employee/account snapshot, or minimal termination details. Select a scenario below.

200.description: Saved successfully. An identical retry returns the same acknowledgement without repeating changes.

400.description: Invalid request or business rule: correct the payload or identity conflict before resubmitting.

500.description: Processing failed. Retry with the same eventId and unchanged payload.

get.summary: Read employee details and current assignments

parameters.name: includeHistory
parameters.description: Include removed role assignments alongside current assignments.

get.description: Returns current assignments by default. Set includeHistory=true to include removed assignments. Accounts remain present when their assignments array is empty.

get.summary: Read processing result without the HR payload

eventId.description: UUID generated by iPass for this specific event. New change: new UUID. Retry: same UUID and identical payload. PostgreSQL: UUID.

eventType.description: Adds an employee or restores approved access. Requires ACTIVE employment and at least one role.

employeeId.description: Unique, permanent employee ID. Must identify the same person across messages; do not use email as the ID.

sourceSystem.description: Where the employee details came from: Workday or VNDLY.

middleName.description: Employee middle name; null if none.

email.description: Employee contact email supplied by iPass; null or omitted when unavailable. No home-email fallback.

employmentStatus.description: ACTIVE for provisioning and updates; TERMINATED for termination.

hireDate.description: Employment or contractor start date: YYYY-MM-DD.

terminationDate.description: Must be null for an active employee.

businessUnit.description: Employee business unit supplied by iPass.

city.description: Employee work city supplied by iPass.

employeeLastSyncedAt.description: When iPass last synchronized the employee details from Workday or VNDLY.

firstName.description: Manager first name supplied separately by iPass.

middleName.description: Manager middle name; null when unavailable supplied separately by iPass.

lastName.description: Manager last name supplied separately by iPass.

iPassRoles.description: Complete approved Pharos assignments for this Okta account. [] removes all from this account only; missing/null is invalid.

employeeClass.description: Employee classification supplied by iPass, for example Employee or Contractor.

supplier.description: Contractor supplier name from iPass. Optional; null or omitted when unavailable or not applicable.

oktaAccountId.description: Okta account whose complete current Pharos role list is supplied.

user.description: Complete employee profile, manager, jobDetails, flat oktaAccountId and current Pharos role snapshot.

UserUpdatedEvent.title: USER_UPDATED — Update employee
UserUpdatedEvent.description: Updates an active employee. Send every remaining role; an empty list removes all roles for the specified account.

eventId.description: UUID generated by iPass for this specific event. New change: new UUID. Retry: same UUID and identical payload. PostgreSQL: UUID.

eventType.description: Closes all employee assignments in this database. Keeps employee and access history.

employeeId.description: Unique, permanent employee ID. Must identify the same person across messages; do not use email as the ID.

employmentStatus.description: ACTIVE for provisioning and updates; TERMINATED for termination.

terminationDate.description: Save the source termination date when supplied. Not required to disable access.

user.description: Send employeeId, TERMINATED employmentStatus and terminationDate when known. Additional fields are ignored.

UserTerminatedEvent.title: USER_TERMINATED — Terminate employee
UserTerminatedEvent.description: Disables employee access. Only employeeId and employmentStatus are required under user. Optional profile data does not update the saved profile.

EmployeeEvent.title: Employee event
EmployeeEvent.description: Select the schema matching eventType. The default example shows USER_PROVISIONED; USER_UPDATED and USER_TERMINATED have their own examples.

eventId.description: The same UUID received in the request. PostgreSQL: UUID.

employee.description: Stored employee profile using database column names.

assignments.description: Current assignments by default; includeHistory=true also returns removed assignments. assignmentStatus and removedAt distinguish current and removed assignments.

entitlementValue.description: Unique Okta entitlement identifier supplied by iPass.

entitlementType.description: Source entitlement category, for example groups.

roleName.description: Source role name supplied by iPass; stored without inferring an environment.

isAvailableForRequest.description: Requestability metadata. False does not revoke an existing assignment.

isPrivileged.description: Role metadata under the agreed payload shape; does not grant permissions. Confirm its source meaning with iPass.

assignedAt.description: Original assignment time for this account; unchanged while the assignment continues.

assignmentStatus.description: PROVISIONED only. Removed roles are omitted from the account snapshot.

IPassRole.description: One current approved Pharos entitlement. Shared role metadata and account assignment are stored separately.

Job.description: Job details supplied by iPass. All five keys are required for provisioning and updates; unavailable values are null.

CorrelationId.description: Pharos-generated UUID for this HTTP request. Quote it when troubleshooting. Retries receive a new correlation ID; eventId remains unchanged.
